chapter: The Many Matters Learned in One's Travels
act_title: The Many Matters Learned in One's Travels

quests.title: The Many Matters Learned in One's Travels

dialogue.sit: <color=#FFCC33FF>Any news?</color>

dialogue.t: Ah, {NICKNAME}, you've come at just the right time — I have something for you.

dialogue.sit: A letter for help? Or a clue to some treasure?
An escort commission, or a search and rescue?

dialogue.t: ...You're certainly very familiar with the kind of work we do, but I'm afraid this has nothing to do with any of the above commissions.
Please, take this brand-new Adventurers' Guild notebook.

dialogue.sit: But I already have the Adventurer Handbook...
Why are you giving me a new one?

dialogue.t: The Adventurer Handbook is for recording details of your completed commissions and intel on all sorts of monsters.
Whereas this notebook is for recording the marvelous people and wonderful events you encounter on your travels.

dialogue.sit: Oh...
That actually sounds kind of useful.

dialogue.t: I hope it will be of help to you. Anyway, that's all for now, my "commission" is complete.
Safe travels, {NICKNAME}. Ad astra abyssosque!
